title: Bioinspired micro-nano photonic materials
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,8434-8468
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00606F, Review Article
Open Access

Chengben Liu, Xiaoyu Hou, Zixin Zhu, Mingzhu Li
This review highlights bioinspired micro-nano photonic materials, focusing on light-manipulation principles and applications in structural colors, sensing, encryption, and optoelectronic devices, with future perspectives.
